episodes.synopsis: Katagiri is housesitting for his friend, who's traveling and needs someone to be there to accept an important package he's expecting. The delivery finally arrives late that evening, but his friend says he's expecting another package the next day and asks him to stay one more night. Katagiri begins to wonder what is in these packages that's so important...
episodes.title: Delivery

episodes.synopsis: Sawako and her young son wait alone at their home in the suburbs for her husband to come home. As the night drags on, Sawako's uneasy feeling begins to turn into fear...
episodes.title: The Sleepless Child

episodes.synopsis: The expedition crew finally make their way inside of Banagawa castle, where they confront the tyrannical machine shogun.

episodes.synopsis: A certain young man visits an art exhibit after receiving a free entry ticket. The lady at the reception desk seems creepy enough, but all the paintings in this bizarre exhibit are like nothing he's seen before. When the young man does something he was advised not to do, an unexpected fate awaits him...
episodes.title: Paintings
